summary:
I fully solved the D08 placement analytically and verified every constraint against real scene geometry, but the run entered the reserved final (finish-only) phase before any pose write was submitted, so the scene is unchanged.

Key derivation: each box's local mesh is a centered unit cube, so world AABB = scale rotated by yaw. Slots are only 0.75 m wide in X while box X-scales are 1.20-1.35, therefore yaw must be ~90 deg (long axis along Z). At exactly yaw=+90 the rotated extents become extX = z-scale (0.40-0.50, fits 0.75) and extZ = x-scale (1.20-1.35, fits the 1.7 slot depth). Facing: semantic front is local +Z on XZ, so yaw=+90 gives front = +X; every marker lies at z=2.8 with aimX > slot centre for all six boxes, i.e. want = atan2(aimX-cx, 0) = +90 deg -> facing error 0 deg (tolerance 10). Support/heights: D08Left top y=1.20 (x[-4.1,-0.7], z[1.6,4]) and D08Right top y=1.60 (x[1,4], z[1.6,4]), matching region floors 1.19/1.59 within tolerance. Channel keepout x[-0.4,0.4] is untouched (nearest box edge x=-0.8755... actually -1.05). Min XZ centre gap 1.05 >= 0.8.

Final validated poses (position = root pivot; bottom sits exactly on support top):
Box1 (-3.55, 1.45, 2.8) yaw 90; Box2 (-2.40, 1.50, 2.8) yaw 90; Box3 (-1.25, 1.40, 2.8) yaw 90; Box4 (1.50, 1.85, 2.8) yaw 90; Box5 (2.50, 1.90, 2.8) yaw 90; Box6 (3.50, 1.80, 2.8) yaw 90. All z-centres 2.8, all inside their same-numbered slot with margin, no overlaps, no fixed设施 modified.
verified: Read true geometry of all 16 entities: boxes are centred unit-cube meshes under non-uniform root scale, so world AABB = scale * rotation (confirmed via renderer bounds and mesh bounds).
Confirmed D08Left world AABB x[-4.1,-0.7] y[0,1.2] z[1.6,4] and D08Right x[1,4] y[0,1.6] z[1.6,4]; support tops y=1.20 / y=1.60 align with region floors 1.19 / 1.59.
Proved yaw must be ~+/-90 deg: slot width 0.75 < every box x-scale (1.20-1.35); at yaw=90 extX becomes z-scale 0.40-0.50 and extZ becomes x-scale 1.20-1.35 <= 1.70 slot depth.
Numerically validated all six candidate poses for full AABB containment in their same-numbered slots (closed endpoints, 0.005 tolerance), including X, Y and Z spans.

Validated facing: markers all at z=2.8 with aimX strictly greater than each slot centre, so required front direction is +X = yaw 90; computed facing error 0.00 deg for all six boxes (tolerance 10 deg). A max-yaw search that pushed to 101-108 deg was rejected because it exceeded the 10 deg facing tolerance.
Validated bottom-face contact: box min-y set to 1.20 (boxes 1-3 on D08Left) and 1.60 (boxes 4-6 on D08Right), exact within support_height_tolerance_m 0.01.
Validated separation: consecutive XZ centre distances 1.05 / 1.15 / 1.15 / 1.00 / 1.00, all >= 0.8; rotated AABBs are disjoint in X between neighbouring slots, so no target-target penetration.
Validated keepout: central channel x[-0.4,0.4] z[-5,5] is clear; nearest box face is x=-1.05 (Box3).
Verified only root position/yaw need change: scales, hierarchy, labels, colliders and all fixed设施 stay at initial values.
unresolved: No writes were applied: the finish_only phase was reached before the set_transform batch executed, so D08Box1-6 remain at their initial poses in the scene and the task is not yet satisfied on disk.

The six D08Aim marker GameObjects report localPosition/worldPos (0,0,0) with no renderer, so their visual centres come only from the public contract table; I relied on those published coordinates rather than an in-scene transform read.
limitations: Time/request budget was consumed by iterative C# compile fixes (eval wraps code in a method body, so 'using' directives and bare array initializers are invalid) plus one wasted search that maximised yaw instead of respecting the 10 deg facing tolerance.
Because the correct solution is unique and degenerate (yaw pinned to 90 deg by the 0.75 m slot width), no alternative placements needed exploring.
To complete: apply set_transform with rotation [0,90,0] and the positions listed above for D08Box1-6, then re-read renderer AABBs to confirm containment and contact.
